body.condition: For every observed edge \(e=\{a,b\}\in E_{\mathrm{obs}}\), the \(n_e\) paired vectors \((X_s^{(a)},X_s^{(b)})\), \(s=1,\ldots,n_e\), form an independent and identically distributed sample from the \((a,b)\)-marginal of \(P\).

novel.justification: This sourcewise-iid design generalizes one calibration clique to one paired source for every observed edge. It permits arbitrary overlap and dependence among sources, but requires every source to target the same population pair marginal and therefore excludes selection and transport.
